demos.title: A secure customer-support agent (ADK + MCP + A2A)
demos.summary: Every message passes a sanitizer, a security judge and a guardrail; every reply is masked; every tool call is checked in code. Run the slides' requests through each layer, with and without the checks.
optional: ANTHROPIC_API_KEY (runs in mock mode without it)

demos.title: A hotel voice reservation agent, one variable at a time
demos.summary: The workshop's five steps: the tools alone, then Claude in text, then voice on your laptop, then a WebRTC room, then a guide to taking phone calls. Checks availability, books rooms, answers policy questions from a knowledge file, and logs the latency of every turn.
optional: a free LiveKit Cloud project (from step 03)

demos.title: Cascaded vs speech-to-speech, head to head
demos.summary: The Week 4 support agent on a phone call, built as a cascade (speech-to-text, Claude, text-to-speech) and as speech-to-speech (Gemini Live). The same 15 recorded questions play into both at real speed; the benchmark scores latency, tool use, accuracy, leaks and cost, with 95% intervals.
optional: ANTHROPIC_API_KEY, a free LiveKit Cloud project and GOOGLE_API_KEY (to run the benchmark)

demos.title: Tracing, a golden set, a release gate and a nightly judge
demos.summary: The Week 4 support agent with the after-launch layer: a trace of every request with its time and cost, a golden dataset that gates every release in CI, and a nightly judge that catches drift as a falling score.
needs: the c4-secure-support-agent folder (clone the whole repository)
optional: ANTHROPIC_API_KEY (runs in mock mode without it)
